newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIAN LEV ENDS WEAKER AT 201.10/30 PER DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIAN LEV ENDS WEAKER AT 201.10/30 PER DOLLAR.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev ended at 201.10/30 per dollar, weaker than 200 in the morning amid nervous trade on the interbank forex market due to expectations of a further lev's slide, dealers said.
"Dollar demand from clients pressured the lev to 201.10/30 per dollar at the close," a bank dealer said.
The dollar was bid at 201 levs and was offered at 202 at the end of the trade but no deals were identified at 202, dealers said.
Foreign currency supply was insufficient to cover fully today's demand from clients despite dollar sales by the Bulgarian National Bank (BNB), dealers said.
The BNB offered limited volumes of foreign currency to selected banks but this just slowed down the lev's fall until the close, said a central bank official.
Traders said they expected the lev's decline to continue tomorrow as dollar demand was expected to run high again amid the current low liquidity in the market.

The dollar was quoted at 199-200 levs on the cash market but bank dealers said that the quotes were likely to rise by two or three levs on Tuesday if the lev's slide on the interbank market continues. -- Dessislava Popova, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
